description: A Bash script containing common utility functions for build automation in TensorFlow's CI build system. Includes functions for color output, error handling, path resolution, timing, running tests, and configuring Android workspace.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits with code 1.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of a given file path.

methods.name: calc_elapsed_time
methods.description: Calculates and returns the elapsed time between two timestamps.

methods.name: run_in_directory
methods.description: Copies and runs a test script inside a specified directory, logging output.

methods.name: test_runner
methods.description: Runs a suite of tests, reports results, logs failures, and exits with status.

methods.name: configure_android_workspace
methods.description: Modifies the WORKSPACE file to include Android SDK and NDK repositories based on environment variables.
